selection.scope: each image and each scale independently
selection.ordering: first-stage error descending; ties use ascending raster index

transport.mask_coding: one start bit plus fixed-width binary (run_length-1) fields
transport.logical_frames_per_image: first_s0, first_s1, mask_rle_s0, mask_rle_s1, second_active_s0, second_active_s1
transport.corrupt_rle_concealment: crop decoded overflow; extend the last emitted run value through decoded underflow
transport.active_payload_mapping: map A_tx decoded refinement indices to received-mask active positions in raster order; truncate surplus payload or zero-fill surplus received active positions
transport.framing_metadata: segment boundaries, shapes, K, source segment lengths, and A_tx are assumed known out of band
